review_candidates.title: Procurement Transformation Sales and Solutions - AGM - PAN India - GO/JC/4458/2026
review_candidates.description: Job Title - Procurement Transformation Sales and Solutions – AGM – PAN India Candidate Expectations & Responsibilities The Transformation Sales and Solutions Leader for Procurement will drive transformation-led growth across procurement, sourcing, category management and source-to-pay operations. The role will shape client solutions that improve procurement efficiency, compliance, stakeholder experience, spend visibility, cycle time, savings realization and operating model maturity through consulting, digital platforms, automation, analytics and AI-enabled transformation levers. Key Responsibilities 17+ years of experience in procurement transformation, sales & solutioning ,operations, sourcing, consulting, BPM/IT solutioning, transformation or shared services leadership. Graduate degree required; MBA/PGDM or supply chain/procurement certification preferred. Lean Six Sigma, CIPS, CPSM, PMP, Agile or equivalent credentials will be an advantage. Demonstrated experience in leading cross-functional solutioning teams, large transformation pursuits or procurement transformation programs. Originate, qualify and shape procurement transformation opportunities across existing and new clients in collaboration with sales and delivery leadership. Lead large deal pursuits, proactive proposals, RFI/RFP responses, solution workshops, client presentations and solution defence sessions. Design end-to-end procurement transformation roadmaps covering source-to-contract, procure-to-pay, supplier management, category management and spend analytics. Develop solution blueprints, target operating models, transition assumptions, technology levers, governance models and value realization plans. Engage CPO, CFO, CIO, shared services and business stakeholders to articulate transformation outcomes and recommended operating models. Collaborate with platform, ERP, automation, analytics, transition, pricing, legal and commercial teams to build integrated solution responses. Create reusable procurement solution assets, benchmarks, maturity models, case studies and value levers for repeatable pursuit support. Guide solution architects, SMEs and transformation consultants during discovery, solutioning, proposal development and handover to delivery. Deep understanding of procurement operations including S2C, P2P, supplier onboarding, contract management, catalog management, buying channels and invoice support interfaces. Knowledge of category management, tail-spend management, supplier performance, compliance, risk controls and procurement policy governance. Experience with procurement platforms or adjacent ERP ecosystems such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, ServiceNow, workflow and analytics platforms is preferred. Ability to define KPIs such as savings, compliance, cycle time, touchless processing, first-time-right, supplier response time and user experience metrics. Strong consultative selling skills with ability to identify procurement pain points and convert them into solution themes and value propositions. Exposure to commercial constructs, pricing assumptions, workload drivers, productivity levers, transition risks and benefit commitments. Practical knowledge of automation, AI/GenAI, analytics, process mining, workflow, document intelligence and self-service enablement in procurement processes. Ability to present to senior stakeholders with clear linkage between business objectives, transformation levers, operating model and value outcomes

review_candidates.description: Sök jobbet Är du en person som vill koda för något större än bara nästa feature? Vill du nörda ner dig i teknik samtidigt som du förbättrar hela Sveriges hälsa? Då kan det här vara en roll för dig. Om tjänsten Som systemutvecklare på E‑hälsomyndigheten blir du en viktig del av ett tvärfunktionellt och agilt team där ni tillsammans skapar lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för samhället. Vi ser att du kan vara i början av din karriär och vårt mål är att du på sikt blir en vass fullstackutvecklare som ledigt rör dig mellan backend i Java och frontend i Vue. Hos oss är kvalitet inte bara ett mål – det är en självklar del av arbetet. Tillsammans med dina kollegor tar du ansvar för att den kod ni levererar håller hög standard och är hållbar över tid. Ni stöttar varandra där det behövs, oavsett om det handlar om utveckling, design, drift eller test. Vi uppmuntrar dig till att ta ett stort eget ansvar, samtidigt som du blir en del av en kultur där samarbete och helhetstänk är centralt. Här får du både växa som utvecklare och bidra till att skapa framtidens digitala lösningar för e‑hälsa. Om dig Vi söker dig som är samarbetsvillig och hjälpsam. Du tar ansvar för teamets arbete och strävar efter att leverera hållbara lösningar med hög kvalitet. Som person är du nyfiken, initiativrik och vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och ett flexibelt förhållningssätt på jobbet. Vi söker dig som har: minst två-årig eftergymnasial utbildning inom it/systemutveckling erfarenhet av systemutveckling, antingen från jobb eller studier goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift. Det är meriterande för tjänsten om du har erfarenhet av följande från jobb eller studier: arbete med databashantering arbete med containerbaserad teknik att konstruera och genomföra automatiserade tester arbete i Java arbete i Vue eller React. Vad erbjuder vi? E-hälsomyndigheten är en myndighet i tillväxt och vi driver utvecklingen av nationell digital infrastruktur inom hälsa, vård och omsorg. Vi skapar förutsättningar för digitala tjänster och lösningar för både privatpersoner och professioner inom hälso- och sjukvård, apotek och socialtjänst. Vi arbetar för att hälsodata ska bli tillgängliga i hela vårdkedjan. Vi är cirka 700 medarbetare i Kalmar och Stockholm. Hos oss finns möjlighet att göra skillnad i en innovativ miljö med trevliga och kompetenta arbetskamrater. Alla medarbetare har förtroendearbetstid och kan arbeta delvis på distans. Läs mer om E-hälsomyndigheten som arbetsplats: Jobba hos oss Är du intresserad? Frågor angående tjänsten besvaras av rekryterande chef Christoffer Eid: 010-106 0816. review_candidates.title: Experienced / Inexperienced Russian ⇄ English Remote Medical Interpreter (OPI/VRI)
review_candidates.description: Company Description Multilingual Interpreters and Translators is a language service and business solutions company headquartered in Winter Haven, Florida, with international operations across Egypt and most Latin American countries. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality multilingual communication services, emphasizing cultural awareness, respect, and mutual benefit for all parties. Its mission is to enhance partner productivity and workforce capacity while maintaining strict standards and secure, reliable language solutions. To support global operations, the company uses proprietary cloud-based “Language Management” and “Multilingual Operations” systems, as well as a web-based training center. With hundreds of interpreters, translators, multilingual staff, and projects each month, Multilingual Interpreters and Translators provides around-the-clock services to clients worldwide. Role Description This is a full-time, remote role for a Russian ⇄ English Medical Interpreter working via Over-the-Phone (OPI) and Video Remote Interpreting (VRI). Day-to-day tasks include accurately interpreting spoken communication between patients, families, and healthcare professionals in Russian and English, ensuring clarity, neutrality, and confidentiality at all times. The interpreter will handle medical appointments, consultations, follow-up calls, and administrative interactions, adhering to industry standards and ethical guidelines. Responsibilities also include maintaining up-to-date knowledge of medical terminology, using company-provided platforms and tools, attending periodic training sessions, and following established procedures for scheduling, documentation, and quality assurance. Both experienced and inexperienced candidates are encouraged to apply, as training and support may be provided. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Medical Interpretation and Interpreting skills to facilitate clear, accurate communication in healthcare settings. Candidates should possess Medical Terminology knowledge in both English and Russian to interpret clinical information reliably. High proficiency in spoken and written Russian and English, with excellent listening and note-taking skills. Ability to maintain professionalism, neutrality, and confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA and relevant privacy regulations. Reliable internet connection, suitable remote work setup, and comfort using OPI/VRI and cloud-based communication platforms. Relevant training or certification in medical interpretation is preferred; prior experience in healthcare or call center environments is an advantage. Strong customer service orientation, cultural sensitivity, and ability to work flexible schedules to support 24/7 operations. Willingness to complete a 2 week training (10 business days) for candidates with no prior experience in remote medical interpretation. Benefits: Payment in USD Collaborative Team Environment Remote Work (Work from Home) If you’re interested, please send your resume through amr.moanes@multilingualint.com Or click on easy apply.

review_candidates.title: Electrical Maintenance Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Electrical Maintenance Engineer (Edible Oil Refinery & Packaging) Company: Al Porsaideya for Food Industries Location: [Insert City/Location, e.g., Port Said, Egypt] Workplace Type: On-site Job Type: Full-time Industry: Food & Beverages Manufacturing, Industrial Automation Seniority Level: Mid-Senior level (3–5 years experience) Job Description: A leading cooking oil refining and bottling factory is seeking to hire an experienced Electrical Maintenance Manager to lead the electrical maintenance team and oversee all maintenance activities related to electrical systems and equipment. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring optimal equipment performance, minimizing downtime, and adhering to safety and quality standards. About the Role: Al Porsaideya for Food Industries is seeking a skilled and proactive Electrical Maintenance Engineer to join our state-of-the-art, fully automated edible oil refining and packaging facility. You will be responsible for ensuring maximum uptime, safety, and efficiency of our advanced European production lines, ranging from high-capacity refining towers to high-speed bottling and robotics. Key Responsibilities: Automation & Controls: Troubleshoot, program, and maintain PLC/SCADA systems and Distributed Control Systems (DCS) to ensure uninterrupted oil processing. Machinery Maintenance: Service heavy-duty electric motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), centrifugal separators, and industrial agitators. High-Speed Packaging Lines: Calibrate and repair electrical systems for automated PET blow-molding, volumetric filling, capping, and robotic palletizing systems (handling 350ml up to 20L containers). Instrumentation: Calibrate precision sensors, temperature transmitters, flow meters, and pressure switches to maintain optimal process parameters. Preventive & Predictive Action: Execute daily/weekly preventive maintenance schedules and conduct infrared thermography on electrical panels and sub-stations. Food Safety Compliance: Ensure all electrical installations and enclosures (IP65/IP66) comply with HACCP , ISO 22000 , and national food safety standards during Clean-in-Place (CIP) cycles. Required Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, or Mechatronics Engineering. Experience: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on electrical maintenance experience specifically within the food, beverage, or fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) industries (Edible oil refinery experience is a major plus). Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in PLC troubleshooting (Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or similar), VFD configuration, and industrial instrumentation. Soft Skills: Sharp root-cause analysis, ability to work under pressure during critical breakdowns, and excellent teamwork. How to Apply: Interested candidates are invited to send their updated CV with the job title in the subject line to: career@portsfi.com
